title: GCT USB4720 product specification, 16 pin Type C Receptacle, Mid-Mount, SMT, IP67 (rev. A2, 12/02/26)
supports: §4.1 current rating: 5.00 A collectively for VBUS pins ("i.e., pins A9, B9"); 6.25 A collectively for GND pins ("i.e., pins A12, B12"); 1.25 A for VCONN (A5/B5)
§4.2-4.4: 48 V DC, 240 W, operating -30 to +85 C

§6.1: LLCR 40 mOhm max initial (20 mV, 100 mA); insulation resistance 100 MOhm min at 100 V DC; dielectric strength 100 V AC 1 min; temperature rise <= 30 C at the shell surface at 5 A VBUS + 1.25 A VCONN, 0.25 A on the other contacts
§6.2: mating force 5-20 N initial; unmating 8-20 N up to 30 cycles, 6-20 N after 20,000 cycles; durability 20,000 cycles (contact resistance 50 mOhm max after)
§6.3.3 thermal shock -55 to +85 C; §6.3.8 waterproof test: mounted in the specified enclosure, 1 m water for 30 minutes per IEC 60529:2013, no leakage; §6.3.9 dust-tight test per IEC 60529:2013
§7.0 reflow: peak 255 C (-0/+5), time above 217 C 60 s, above 230 C 50 s, above 250 C 5 s, soak 2-3 min, ramp 2.5 C/s, cooling 5 C/s max

§8: tape and reel in a vacuum-sealed moisture barrier bag with desiccant; MSL rating 6 (non-JEDEC); store +5 to +30 C, 40-90% RH; bake at 60 C <= 5% RH for 24 h before reflow; otherwise air leakage performance after reflow is impacted
§9 Group A-7 durability: the plug or socket is rotated 180° between blocks of cycles
